mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay_payment(payment_no,order_no,member_id,channel,app_key,amount,status,attempt_no,expires_at_epoch_second) VALUES(#{paymentNo},#{orderNo},#{memberId},#{channel},#{appKey},#{amount},'WAITING',#{attemptNo},#{expiresAtEpochSecond}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payment_no=payment_no
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pay_payment WHERE payment_no=#{paymentNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pay_payment SET status='CLOSED', update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE payment_no=#{paymentNo} AND status='WAITING'

UPDATE pay_payment SET status='SUCCESS', paid_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, channel_trade_no=#{channelTradeNo}, notify_id=#{notifyId}, channel_fee_rate=#{channelFeeRate}, channel_fee_amount=#{channelFeeAmount}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE payment_no=#{paymentNo} AND order_no=#{orderNo} AND channel=#{channel} AND amount=#{amount} AND status IN ('WAITING','CLOSED')
